commands.command:
set -euo pipefail
test "$(uname -s)" = Darwin
export GIT_TERMINAL_PROMPT=0
WORK="$(mktemp -d /tmp/bloomml-repair-qa.XXXXXX)"
trap 'rm -rf "$WORK"' EXIT
git clone --quiet --branch main https://github.com/MichalMatu/bloomml.git "$WORK/repo"
cd "$WORK/repo"
EXPECTED="cf1c4343a94862d75213093e7b528f56813c587b"
test "$(git rev-parse HEAD)" = "$EXPECTED"
echo "SOURCE_SHA|$EXPECTED"
echo "PRECHECK_CLEAN|$(test -z "$(git status --porcelain)" && echo yes || echo no)"
echo "SERIAL_120_PRESENT|$(test -e /dev/cu.usbserial-120 && echo yes || echo no)"
gate() {
  label="$1"; shift
  echo "GATE_START|$label"
  set +e
  "$@" > "$WORK/$label.log" 2>&1
  code=$?
  set -e
  echo "GATE_EXIT|$label|$code"
  tail -32 "$WORK/$label.log"
}
gate WEB sh -c 'cd web && pnpm install --offline --frozen-lockfile && pnpm gate'
gate PANEL_SECURITY python3 -m pytest -q tests/test_panel_request_security.py tests/test_panel.py
gate CMAKE_HOST make test-host HOST_BUILD_JOBS=2
gate PYTHON_COMPILE python3 -m compileall -q tools scripts
gate DIFF_CHECK git diff --check 54c486dae121517161efd6d3d3498e5b4623e1fc HEAD
echo "POSTCHECK_CLEAN|$(git status --porcelain | wc -l | tr -d ' ')"
echo "GATES_DONE"
